title: Write Directions for a Group Walk

source.rights: 原创 AI 辅助虚构教学材料，尚待发布前独立审核。

instructions: Write your own first draft; the fictional example is for study, not your submission.
prompt: Write 120–160 words to a group about a fictional walk. Give a meeting place and a clear route, explain one possible change, and identify a second meeting place. Use at least six lesson words and make the meaning of each pronoun clear.

guidedOutput.title: 写作结构提示
guidedOutput.text: Write four short parts: meeting place; route and landmarks; an alternative if a path is closed; contact and second meeting place. Check every it, they and this.

reference: Hello everyone, our walk will begin beside the station at ten on Sunday. Please wait on the sidewalk near the blue clock, which is our first landmark. From there we will follow the path east toward the stream. We will stop at the shelter for a short break before continuing through the meadow. The guide will check the notice before we leave. If the narrow trail is muddy, we will take the wider path beside the field instead. Our second meeting place is the visitor center, not the old bridge. I will send the guide's number separately. Anyone who cannot see the group should call the guide. Someone will stay with the guide while we check that everyone has arrived. Please read the latest park information before you travel.
referenceLabel: 原创示例，仅供学习；不要作为自己的待提交作文。
